post.description:
The composed chain of the verification methodology, end to end, with every step's state.

freeze (M3) -> formalize (M2) -> fidelity (M1) -> vacuity (M4) -> obligations (M5) -> seams (M6) -> discharge
(M8) -> trust ladder (M7). A non-verdict stops the chain: later steps are NOT_RUN and `formal_status` is that
non-verdict; nothing undecided is reported as decided. Prose needs the configured formalizer model. A
`mechanism` is compiled without a model, and a `biomedical` block adds units, conventions and domain probes
(ADR-086).

Everything an EvidenceRequest can point at: lifecycle projects, packages, register rows and formal cases.

post.description:
Paper range vs formal range of one theorem, decided by z3: the strength of the formal statement.

`relation` is EQUIVALENT, STRONGER (the formal range is strictly larger), WEAKER or INCOMPARABLE, with a witness
for every non-empty difference. When the solver gives up, or a division by zero is reachable in the encoding,
`formal_status` is UNDECIDED and `undecided_reasons` says why; that is a non-verdict, never a relation.

Junk-value lint of a Lean statement file: every site of a total-function convention, DISCHARGED or OPEN.

DISCHARGED names the statement text that rules the junk branch out; OPEN means a human decides. The lint is
syntactic and never runs Lean, so the statement stays NOT_KERNEL_CHECKED.
Freezes a protocol or checklist by the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes, the digest a lifecycle ARTIFACT records.

Freezes what would count as support or refutation of a hypothesis against its rivals, before any evaluation.

The criteria are the discriminating states, computed from the formal objects alone (no observations). The freeze
has a SHA-256, a time and an author, recorded in a hash-chained log. Freezing the same content again returns the
earliest freeze (`already_frozen`).

get.description: One freeze record: kind, SHA-256, author, time, the frozen content and any lifecycle anchor.

post.description: VERIFIED (DECIDED) or CHANGED/UNKNOWN (BLOCKED): does the freeze still hold for what is about to be used?
Logical relation between two hypotheses over the same state space, with discriminating states.

Whether a consequence holds wherever the hypothesis applies and its claims hold, with counterexamples.

With `include_lean`, the response also carries the consequence stated as a Lean 4 theorem. It is not
kernel-checked by this server.

Exact evaluation (enumeration, or SMT when a variable is continuous): content, conflicts, counterexamples.

With `hypothesis.non_witnesses`, each declared non-witness is probed; if one satisfies the claims, the verdict is
VACUOUS_RELATIVE_TO_INTENT and `intent_probe` carries the witness. `default_probes` adds generic trivial witnesses,
which are advisory. `claim_trust` gives each claim's trust-ladder rung (ADR-080).

`obligation_ledger` (ADR-085) is the ADR-076 ledger of the evaluation: fidelity, vacuity, each claim, each cited
result's use and each prediction, with the weakest-link roll-up on the trust ladder. With `freeze`, the frozen
criteria are verified first and a mismatch is refused with 409 and formal_status BLOCKED.

Prose -> N formal objects (by the configured local model) -> self-consistency gate -> exact evaluation.

The gate (ADR-DISCOVERY-064) accepts a formalization only when a strict majority of the samples is proved
logically equivalent; otherwise the response is FORMALIZATION_AMBIGUOUS and carries no evaluation. An accepted
object is still a draft: the researcher must confirm it says what the prose meant.

get.description: The checklist of every stage: each check's kind (VERIFIER, HUMAN, ARTIFACT, RUBRIC) and threshold.
Stalled stages, pending sign-offs, unreleased reports, and artifacts that changed after they were recorded.

post.description:
Seams of one manuscript: unresolved citations and every import from a cited source as an OPEN obligation.

`citation_gate.status` is PASS, FAIL, or NO_BIBLIOGRAPHY (then `formal_status` is UNDECIDED: the gate cannot
judge, which is a non-verdict, never a pass). `imports` lists CONVENTION_TRANSFER, HYPOTHESIS_MATCH (MATCHED,
UNMATCHED or NO_ENTRY against the optional `registry`), DEPENDENCY and EFFECTIVE_CONSTANT obligations with file
and line. Detection is lexical; obligations are never discharged here. `claim_trust` is a view beside the report:
a prose claim stays CLAIMED.

get.description: Every registered proof case with its claim status (weakest-link roll-up) and whether its audit passes.

The case's ledger (claim, obligations, discharges) and the audit of its proofs: every report present and
verified, hashes equal to the manifest, no proof STALE against its sources, consistent roll-up. A claim's status
is only reported together with its audit.

post.description: ADR-ONTOLOGY-035: Atomically applies an approved plan to the ontology state.
ADR-ONTOLOGY-035: Computes epistemic blast radius for proposed ontology mutations.
ADR-ONTOLOGY-035: Immediately rolls back a previously applied transaction.

Checks one use of a registered result: conventions match and hypotheses are entailed by the citing context.

`outcome` is CLEAR (all discharged and matched, entry active), FINDINGS (a mismatch, an undischarged hypothesis
with counterexamples, or a retracted entry) or INCOMPLETE (nothing contradicts, but something is UNDECIDED or
UNSPECIFIED). Only a formal entailment discharges a hypothesis; a phrase in the text is STATED_IN_TEXT.
Records that a claim or entry uses another. Edges that would close a cycle are refused.
Adds a cited result or premise, or a new version of one. The source is provenance, never evidence.

get.description: One entry (the latest version unless `version` is given), with its re-evaluation flag if any.

post.description:
Retracts an entry (or downgrades it to a lower rung) and flags every transitive dependent.

A flagged dependent's rung is capped at CLAIMED until it is re-evaluated.
Clears a dependent's re-evaluation flag; the note records how it was re-checked.

get.description: Every claim or entry that transitively depends on `node`, with any re-evaluation flags.

The regression cases, with the version and SHA-256 of the frozen expectations and each case's frozen
observations. Expectations change only through `coresearcher regression update`, never through the API.

post.description:
Runs the selected cases (all when `case_ids` is empty) offline and compares them with the frozen expectations.

`status` is PASS only when every observation equals its expectation. Otherwise it is the worst of ERROR (a case
could not run), REGRESSION, FIXTURE_CHANGED, CHANGED and IMPROVEMENT (better, but not yet frozen).

The trust-ladder rung of each claim, from recorded evidence, by mechanical rules.

CLAIMED -> STATEMENT_PUBLIC -> STATEMENT_AUDITED -> KERNEL_CHECKED -> INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED. Each rung reports
whether it is met and, if not, which rule failed. NOT_KERNEL_CHECKED never counts as a kernel check.
